instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. At an outdoor campsite, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a beige top stands on the left, embracing the bearded man in the navy shirt (R2) on the right. She looks up at him with a soft smile, her arms wrapped around his torso. The bearded man (R2), wearing a green plaid scarf and plaid pants, looks down at her lovingly, holding her in a warm embrace. Soft natural daylight illuminates the couple against a background of green trees and a blue tent.
